overall_goal: Organize ingredients, weigh items, retrieve utensils, wash hands, and clean up the workspace.

goals.description: Clear the electric hob and sink area.
goals.rationale: The person turns off the electric hob, moves the pan, and places the spatula in the sink to clear the workspace.

goals.description: Organize ingredients to set up a wrap-making station.
goals.rationale: The person gathers bowls of lettuce, chicken, tomato, and onion, placing them together to create a centralized station for making wraps.

goals.description: Weigh the cut lemon and record its weight.
goals.rationale: The person sets up the weighing scale, places a cut lemon on it, and notes down the measured weight in a notebook.

goals.description: Retrieve a serving bowl from the cabinet.
goals.rationale: The person opens the cabinet, takes out a white serving bowl, and closes the cabinet door.

goals.description: Troubleshoot and reset the kitchen weighing scale.
goals.rationale: The person moves items to make space and repeatedly presses buttons on the weighing scale to reset it to zero after it fails to register.

goals.description: Retrieve Sriracha sauce and yogurt from storage.
goals.rationale: The person opens the lower shelf and refrigerator to take out the Sriracha sauce and a container of yogurt.

goals.description: Retrieve a teaspoon and scoop yogurt.
goals.rationale: The person opens the cutlery drawer, selects a teaspoon, and uses it to scoop yogurt from the container.
The person turns on the tap, washes their hands, and dries them using a kitchen rag.

goals.description: Record the weight of the yogurt.
goals.rationale: The person picks up a marker, opens it, and writes down the weight of the yogurt in the notebook.

goals.description: Retrieve a tablespoon from the cutlery drawer.
goals.rationale: The person opens the cutlery drawer and picks up a fresh tablespoon.

goals.description: Discard the squeezed lemon and seeds into the bin.
goals.rationale: The person picks up the squeezed lemon and a spoon, throwing the lemon and shaking the seeds from the spoon into the rubbish bin.

goals.description: Turn off and put away the weighing scale.
goals.rationale: The person turns off the electronic weighing scale and moves it to the corner of the chopping board.
The person washes their hands under the tap, shakes off excess water, and dries them with a kitchen rag, also wiping off dirt.
The person collects used tablespoons, a fork, and a knife, stacking them together on the chopping board.

goals.description: Close and put away condiment jars into the shelf.
goals.rationale: The person screws the caps back onto the salt and pepper jars, then places them along with the parsley jar back into the bottom shelf.

goals.description: Clean the yogurt spoon and add it to the used cutlery pile.
goals.rationale: The person taps the spoon against the yogurt container to remove excess yogurt and places it on the pile of used cutlery.
